# Chapters 9 and 10: systems for level-builders

Logic is in `src/systems/`, numbers in `src/content/tuning.ts`, types in `src/core/types.ts` and `src/core/chapter.ts`. Tests: `tests/unit/c9c10-*.test.ts` (`c9c10-world.ts` builds a small chapter 9/10 module on one screen; copy its placements). The world view (`src/systems/view/c910View.ts`, pure helpers in `c910.ts`) draws every system below. **No system saves an "already started" flag**: a fight, boss, set piece or puzzle started by a `script` trigger starts again after a load or a return to the bar. Everything new on `ctx` is in `src/core/chapter.ts`.

## Chapter 9

### Seated clerks and the offices

```ts
guards: [{ enemyId: 'clerk', seated: true, route: { mode: 'stationary', waypoints: [{ position, facing: 'down', waitMs: 0 }] } }, ...],
hidingProps: [{ id, kind: 'waterCooler' | 'noticeboard' | 'queue', position, radius }],
```
Seated: cone range x0.6 (48 px), turns to a noise inside its hearing (90 px) for `investigateGiveUpMs`, never leaves the seat, then goes back to its facing. A sneaking Andrew is silent below Fecked, so a sneak past a seated clerk is quiet; walking is not. Planner: add the offices to `stealth-feasibility.test.ts` with `{ name, module: chapter9, sectionId: 'c9.stealth.offices' }`; it plans seated clerks with their short cones (see `c9c10-stealth.test.ts`). A route that must walk past a seated clerk is not planned.

### The Borrowed Glove

At the lost-property box: `ctx.learnMove('borrowedGlove')` (or `ctx.unlockAbility('borrowedGlove')`). It goes in slot 3 if that slot is empty; if not, he still has it. Slot 3 is Bit much. `ctx.hasGlove()` is true from then on, and **E at a gravity switch (gravity rooms, bays 2 and 4, the Administrator's four) works it whatever is in slot 3**. Pressing key 3 with the Glove in slot 3 near a switch, aimed at it, works the switch too (the cone from `ability:glovePulse`).

### Security shields

`security` has `frontalShieldDeg: 120`: a melee swing or a thrown bottle from within 60 deg of where he faces does nothing (`blocked`). Each of these works (tested in `c9c10-systems.test.ts`): from the side or back; the Glove, Lock-in and Bedside Manner (a stunned body has no shield); the Stumble (moves pierce the shield); Barred (removes him). Nothing for the chapter to do but place them.

### `c9.puzzle.gravity`

Three small rooms; a wall switch changes which way is down; everything loose slides toward that wall until something stops it.

```ts
gravityPuzzles: [{ sectionId: 'c9.puzzle.gravity', screenId: 'c9.labs', layout: GRAVITY }],
// ChapterDef.puzzle = { id: 'c9.puzzle.gravity', chapter: 9, kind: 'gravity' }
// examinables: one per switch (`GravitySwitch.examinableId`, at the switch tile), one reset panel per room (`resetExaminableId`).
```
```ts
const GRAVITY: GravityLayout = { rooms: [{
  id: 'room1',
  area: { col: 2, row: 2, width: 6, height: 3 },        // the floor, screen tiles; everything outside it is wall
  crates: [], fixed: [],                                  // fixed: pillars inside the floor
  plates: [], ledges: [{ id: 'l1', col: 7, row: 2 }],     // plates: a crate must rest on each; ledges: Andrew must come to rest on one
  switches: [{ id: 'r1.s', examinableId: 'c9.gravity.sw1', dir: 'right', col: 2, row: 1 }],  // on a wall tile, worked from a tile beside it
  andrewStart: { col: 2, row: 2 },
  resetExaminableId: 'c9.gravity.reset1',
}, /* room2, room3 */ ] };
```
The sample (`sampleGravity()` in `tests/unit/c9c10-world.ts`) is the three rooms of the brief: room 1 one switch, Andrew slides onto a ledge; room 2 two switches, a crate must end on a plate; room 3 two switches, a crate Andrew pushes against a pillar stops him on a ledge when he slides.

Rules (`gravity.ts`):
- E at a switch (Glove needed) sets the room's gravity to the switch's `dir`. Every crate in the room, and Andrew if he is standing in it, slides to the wall or the next body. Andrew is carried along (`forced` slide, controls held) for `overhaul.gravity.slideMsPerTile` x tiles (min `minSlideMs`).
- Crates are pushed a tile at a time by walking into them (as the kegs) and block Andrew. Gravity acts only at a switch, never continuously: a crate pushed onto a ledge stays there until a switch moves it, so it needs a pillar or a wall behind it.
- A room is solved when every plate is covered and, if it has ledges, Andrew has come to rest on one **by sliding** (standing on one does not count). Solved rooms stay solved and their switches stop working. When all three are solved the puzzle completes (the reward and `section:completed`).
- Per-room reset: E at the room's reset panel puts the crates back and gravity at rest (an unsolved room only). If Andrew stands on a crate's start tile he goes to `andrewStart`. `puzzle.resetRoom(id, andrewTile)` is the same.
- `completeNow()` solves all three (crates on plates). Solved rooms are saved in flag `gravity.<sectionId>` and come back after a load; a bar return keeps the puzzle as it was.
- Events: `gravity:changed` `{ puzzleId, roomId, phase: 'pulled' | 'settled' | 'refused' | 'reset' | 'roomSolved', dir? }`. `refused` is a switch with no Glove: the chapter says its line from the examinable's own dialogue or from `onExamine`.
- The planner: `solveRoom(room, grid)` gives the shortest steps (`walk` a tile, `pull` a switch) or null; `estimateSeconds(steps)` a rough time. `c9c10-gravity.test.ts` runs the plan of every room through the real run (real walking, real E, real slides) and the puzzle completes. **Run the chapter's own layout through `solveRoom` in a test**, as `c9c10-gravity.test.ts` does for the sample (three rooms under two minutes).
- View: floor edge (teal when solved), plates (amber, teal when covered), ledges (pulsing outline), switches (a box with an arrow), crates (`PROP.crate`, interpolated while sliding), an amber arrow in the room corner for the current gravity.

### `c9.setpiece.lockdown`

```ts
bosses: [{
  bossId: 'c9.setpiece.lockdown', screenId: 'c9.hall', trigger: { kind: 'script' }, bodies: [], entrance, callId: 'lockdown',
  exitArea,                       // inside the lift: reaching it ends the set piece
  lockdown: {
    bays: [{ id, area, start, door, guards: [{ enemyId: 'security', position }, { enemyId: 'clerk', position }],
             gravitySwitch?: { examinableId, position, barrier?: AreaRect, slideGuardsTo?: Vec2 },   // bays 2 and 4
             recorder?: { examinableId, position } }, /* x5 */],    // bay 3
    lift: { examinableId, door: AreaRect, wandPosition: Vec2 },
    beyondArea,                   // the lift lobby after bay 5 (counts as having passed it)
    lanyard: { flag: 'lanyard', evidenceId: 'c8.clue.shift' },   // optional; these are the defaults
  },
}],
sections: [{ id: 'c9.setpiece.lockdown', kind: 'setpiece', mykoCallable: true }]
```
The chapter script starts it with `ctx.startSection('c9.setpiece.lockdown')` (from a trigger with `once: false`, or after the announcement) and plays the announcements from the director's events.

- Doors: bay k's timer starts when Andrew first enters its `area` and is `door.telegraphMs` of `c9.setpiece.lockdown` (14000). It is drawn above the door as a row of 14 segments and the door is drawn coming down as it runs. At 0 the door shuts (`doorShut`) and **always** sends Andrew back to the bay's `start` and resets that bay's timer (after `lockdown.doorReopenMs`); if he was within `crushReachPx` of it, it is also a heavy hit (`door.damage` 15, `crushed`). Nothing else resets: earlier bays stay passed. A shut door blocks its tiles.
- Passed: Andrew in a later bay (or `beyondArea`) means this bay is passed, its timer stops and it does not start again. Guards of a bay spawn on first entry, leashed to the bay's `area`, as adds of the set piece.
- Gravity switch (bays 2 and 4): E (with the Glove) or the Glove's pulse. E without the Glove does nothing and fires no event: if the chapter wants a line, check `ctx.hasGlove()` in `onExamine` for that examinable. `barrier` stops blocking (`barrierDropped`); `slideGuardsTo` slides the bay's living guards there over `lockdown.guardSlideMs` and stuns them `guardSlideStunMs` (`guardsSlid`).
- Recorder (bay 3): E starts the take (`takeStarted`); he must stay within `takeReachPx` for `lockdown.takeMs` (3000) or it stops; then `c9.proof.footage` goes in the casebook (`takeDone`, `addEvidence` saves). Proofs are evidence, so a return to the bar leaves the tape taken.
- Lift: E at the panel. All five proofs in the casebook and the lanyard (`ctx.flag('lanyard') === true` or `c8.clue.shift` in the casebook) -> `liftOpen`, the lift door stops blocking, the wand is left (`wandLeft`: a weapon pickup, see below). Otherwise `liftRefused`. The chapter plays the guard's lines on those events and hides his NPC. Reaching `exitArea` ends the set piece.
- A Myko call (`completeNow('myko')`, also the debug walk): `allOpen` (every door, barrier and the lift open), the tape given if not taken, the wand left. The chapter's `onEnd` (`bossHooks`) plays the call scene.
- Return to the bar: the set piece resets to bay 1 (`LockdownDirector.reset()`), the section is started again by the script. The tape stays taken.
- Events: `lockdown:changed` `{ bossId, phase: 'bayEntered' | 'doorLit' | 'doorShut' | 'crushed' | 'bayPassed' | 'barrierDropped' | 'guardsSlid' | 'takeStarted' | 'takeDone' | 'liftRefused' | 'liftOpen' | 'wandLeft' | 'allOpen', bay? }`.
- Examinables to declare: each switch, the recorder, the lift panel. `ctx.lockdown(bossId)` gives the director (`view(boss)`, `doorState(i)`, `leftMs(i)`).

### The wand: `ctx.spawnWeaponPickup(weaponId, position, screenId?)`

A weapon on the floor; walking within `investigation.interactRadius` gains it (`weapon:gained`, saves). Nothing is left if he already has it. Run-time only: if the set piece is done (or was called in) and he does not have the wand, call it again from `onStart`. Drawn with the weapon's icon (`icon.weapon`).

## Chapter 10

### The ticket gate

The anteroom fight starts when Andrew takes ticket 848: **this is a script trigger only**. Examinable on the machine, `onExamine('c10.ticket')` plays `c10.open` and then `ctx.startSection('c10.fight.anteroom')` (placement `trigger: { kind: 'script' }`). Nothing is saved as started: after a bar return the fight is reset and the script (or a trigger with `once: false`) must start it again; `c9c10-systems.test.ts` proves the restart. It is the last place a fight call can be used (callable section).

### `c10.boss.administrator`

```ts
bosses: [{
  bossId: 'c10.boss.administrator', screenId: 'c10.control', trigger: { kind: 'script' }, entrance,
  bodies: [{ tag: 'administrator', position: DESK }],
  administrator: {
    arena: AreaRect,                 // 36 x 20 tiles
    desk: Vec2,                      // where he stands
    guardEntrances: [Vec2, Vec2],    // where a pair of security comes in
    switches: [{ examinableId, position }, /* x4 */],
    furniture: [{ id, position }, ...],   // loose; slides on a flip; the chapter draws NOTHING for it: the view stamps PROP.crate
    stampRows: [tile rows],          // optional; default: Andrew's own row
  },
}],
sections: [{ id: 'c10.boss.administrator', kind: 'boss', mykoCallable: false }]
```
Start it with `ctx.startSection`. Play `c10.admin.intro` first. His body has no attacks of its own: the director plays all five (`stamp`, `gravityFlip`, `stunPulse`, `teleportStrike`, `beamSweep`; the run sets `directedAttackIds`). Numbers: attacks and phases are `TUNING.bosses['c10.boss.administrator']`, the rest `overhaul.administrator`.

- **Phase 1 `delegation`**: desk shield (`BossRunner.guard('administrator', 'front')`; `boss:guarded` fires on a blocked hit). A pair of `security` comes in `callDelayMs` after the start (`guardsCalled`); when both are down the shield drops `shieldDownMs` (`shieldDown`), then comes back (`shieldUp`) and a new pair arrives `callDelayMs` later. One guard down is not enough. Stamp: a floor row lit for the `stamp` telegraph (`stampLit`), then a shockwave from the desk both ways in `stampTravelMs` (`stamp`): heavy if he is on the row (within `stampHalfWidthPx`) as it passes.
- **Phase 2 `restructuring`** (2/3 health): as phase 1, and every `gravityFlip` cooldown (10 s start to start): arrows light toward one of the other three walls for the telegraph, 1.5 s (`gravityLit` with `dir`), then the furniture slides there (`gravityFlip`) taking `furnitureSlideMs`: a heavy hit (`gravityFlip` damage) to Andrew within `furnitureSizePx/2` of a piece as it passes (once per piece). Gravity stays flipped until Andrew puts it back, or the next flip comes round. **E at any of the four switches** (or the Glove's pulse at one) while it is flipped: the furniture slides home (no hit), `gravityBack` (with the far wall's `dir`), he is thrown against the far wall (the wall opposite the flip), stunned `gravityStunMs` (hits land, shield or not), then walks back to the desk at `returnSpeedPx`. E at a switch when nothing is flipped does nothing.
- **Phase 3 `personally`** (1/3 health): `jacketOff`, the sprite becomes `boss.c10.boss.administrator.personally`, the shield and guards go, he walks. He cycles `stunPulse` (a ground marker on Andrew's spot, radius 48; held `holdMs` if he stays; `pulseLit`, `pulse`), `teleportStrike` (a marker `teleportBehindPx` behind Andrew by the way he faces for 600 ms, then he is there and strikes: heavy; `teleportLit`, `teleport`) and `beamSweep` (the 90 deg quarter in front lit for the telegraph, then a beam sweeps it in `beamSweepMs`: worst hit; `beamLit`, `beam`). After every `offerEveryAttacks` attacks: `administrator:changed` `{ phase: 'offer', offer: 1 | 2 | 3 }`, attacks pause `offerPauseMs`. **The chapter plays `c10.admin.offer1`, `offer2`, `offer3` on those events** (the ids exist), and `c10.admin.phase2` / `phase3` from `bossHooks.onPhaseChanged` (`restructuring`, `personally`). Three offers, then no more.
- **End**: he is beaten at 0 health: `sits` (the view's `down` frame; frame wanted below). The chapter plays `c10.admin.end` from `bossHooks.onEnd`.
- **No Myko call**: `c10.boss.administrator` is `NON_CALLABLE_BOSS`. Holding M does not fill the ring (`callHoldProgress()` stays 0), `myko:callRefused` fires and `myko.callRefused.administrator.callsLeft` plays if he has calls left, `myko.callRefused.administrator` if not. Tested through the run in `c9c10-administrator.test.ts`.
- **Return to the cabinet**: the boss resets and the script starts it again; it starts from phase 1 with furniture home (`AdministratorDirector.reset()`).
- Events: `administrator:changed` `{ bossId, phase: 'guardsCalled' | 'shieldDown' | 'shieldUp' | 'stampLit' | 'stamp' | 'gravityLit' | 'gravityFlip' | 'gravityBack' | 'jacketOff' | 'pulseLit' | 'pulse' | 'teleportLit' | 'teleport' | 'beamLit' | 'beam' | 'offer' | 'sits', dir?, offer? }`. `ctx.administrator(bossId)` gives the director (`view(boss)`, `shieldUp`, `flipped`, `currentGravity`, `offersMade`).
- View: shield ring, the lit row and the wave, floor arrows (lit pulsing, then dim), furniture, switch lamps (amber while flippable), pulse marker and burst, teleport marker, the quarter wedge and the beam line.
- Kit check: bottles reach guards behind the shield's edge (they are separate bodies); Stout Slam, Lock-in and the Glove work on the pair (a stunned guard counts as down only when defeated); Second Opinion and One for the Road work on him while the shield is down or he is stunned; Fecked is one beam from the floor (the beam is `worst`).

### `c10.puzzle.broadcast`

```ts
broadcastPuzzles: [{ sectionId: 'c10.puzzle.broadcast', screenId: 'c10.control', layout: BROADCAST }],
// ChapterDef.puzzle = { id: 'c10.puzzle.broadcast', chapter: 10, kind: 'broadcast' }
const BROADCAST: BroadcastLayout = {
  sockets: [{ id: 's1', examinableId: 'c10.socket.1', shape: 'round', look: 'round' }, ...,
            { id: 's4', examinableId, shape: 'flat', look: 'slot' }, { id: 's5', examinableId, shape: 'flatNotched', look: 'slot' }],  // five; two share a `look`
  plugs: [{ proofId: 'c9.proof.craft', shape: 'flat' }, ... one per proof ...],      // shapes match the sockets one to one
  buttonExaminableId: 'c10.button',
  wrongTextId: 'c10.broadcast.wrong',
};
```
`validateBroadcast(layout)` returns problems (empty when sound): five sockets, five plugs, one plug per proof, shapes unique and matching, exactly two sockets share a look. The chapter's tape and photo are the look-alike pair (`c10.hint.broadcast.2` says the tape's has the notch).

What the chapter (or the UI scene) calls, on `ctx.broadcast('c10.puzzle.broadcast')` or `uiState`:
- `views()` / `uiState.activeBroadcast()`: `{ sockets: [{ id, examinableId, shown, examined, ambiguous, plugged }], plugs: [{ proofId, shape, owned, placed }], ready, pressed }`. Draw each socket as `shown` (its `look` until examined or plugged), each plug by `shape`. `owned` is whether the proof is in the casebook (all five are, after chapter 9).
- `examine(socketId)` / E on the socket's examinable (the run does it): its notch shows (`broadcast:changed` `examined`). Give the examinable its own line if it has one.
- `plug(proofId, socketId)` / `uiState.plugProof(puzzleId, proofId, socketId)`: returns `{ ok }` or `{ ok: false, refusal: 'noProof' | 'wrongShape' | 'occupied' | 'alreadyPlugged' | 'unknown' | 'solved', textId? }`. A wrong shape emits `wrong` and returns `textId: layout.wrongTextId` (play it); it costs nothing. `unplug(socketId)` takes a plug out before the fifth.
- The **section completes when the fifth plug goes in** (`ready` then `section:completed`): play `c10.broadcast.ready` from `onSectionCompleted('c10.puzzle.broadcast')` and set the objective `c10.objective.button`.
- `press()` / E at `buttonExaminableId` / `uiState.pressBroadcast(id)`: works once, only after the five are in; emits `broadcast:changed` `pressed` (play `c10.broadcast.sent`, then the reaction cards). `ctx.broadcast(id)?.pressed` is saved.
- `completeNow()` (the Myko call, `c10.call.puzzle`): plugs all five (the right ones), completes the section as `myko`, **leaves the button** (`pressed` is false). The chapter's `onSectionCompleted` should offer the button as above.
- Saved: plugs in flag `broadcast.<sectionId>` (`socketId:proofId,...`), the press in `broadcast.<sectionId>.pressed`; restored on a load. A completed section loads with all five plugged.

### The no-meter screen (`c10.pub`)

`ScreenLayout.noMeter: true` on the pub's layout. Walking in: the meter is hidden (`meter:hiddenChanged`, `meterSnapshot().hidden`), the drain stops, nothing hurts (`hitPlayer` returns false, no `player:hit`), drinking is refused as in chapter 1's hidden meter. Walking out restores all of it. It is **never saved**: `meterHidden` and `drainHeld` stay as the script set them, so a load never starts with the meter gone. (A script that wants the saved kind still has `ctx.setMeterHidden` and `ctx.holdDrain`.)

Sit at the bar: examinable on the stool; `onExamine('c10.pub.stool')` -> `ctx.sitDown(stoolPos, 'up')` (Andrew moves to the stool, faces that way, controls held) then play Dympna's scene; `ctx.standUp()` releases. `run.seated` is `{ pos, facing }` or null. No seated frame in the art: the idle frame facing the bar is the stand-in (frame wanted below).

### Epilogue support

- `ctx.mykoCallsUsed()`: how many Myko calls the whole run used (all chapters; from the save's `mykoCalls`). `callsUsed(records)` is the same on a list. Use it only to choose which line plays: `c10.epilogue.calls.unused` when it is 0, nothing when it is not (the epilogue "does not choose"; nothing is drawn).
- `ctx.playCards(cards: EpilogueCard[]): Promise<void>`: plays a scripted sequence and resolves after the last card. Gameplay (movement, timers of the world, enemies) waits; script timers keep running.
```ts
await ctx.playCards([
  { id: 'gov', kind: 'caption', textId: 'c10.caption.governments', durationMs: 4000 },
  { id: 'news', kind: 'scene', sceneId: 'c10.reaction.news', durationMs: 0 },          // plays the dialogue; the card ends when it has
  { id: 'title', kind: 'title', textId: 'c10.caption.end', durationMs: 0 },           // 0: waits for a key
  { id: 'credits', kind: 'credits', lines: ['c10.credits.line1', 'c10.credits.line2', 'c10.credits.line3', 'c10.credits.thanks'], durationMs: 12000 },
]);
```
  Card kinds: `caption`, `scene`, `title`, `credits`. Events `epilogue:card` `{ index, total, cardId, kind }` per card and `epilogue:done`. A key press skips a timed or waiting card (`uiState.advanceCard()`); a scene card ends only by finishing its dialogue. The UI draws `uiState.activeCard()` = `{ index, total, card }` or null. Durations belong to the chapter (presentation, not balance). The whole reaction (governments, news, Andrew's video, Colleen-Ann, Pruitt) and the credits are one or two calls to this.

`overhaul.gravity`: `slideMsPerTile` 70, `minSlideMs` 200. `overhaul.lockdown`: `takeMs` 3000 (the brief's 3 s), `takeReachPx` 28, `crushReachPx` 20, `doorReopenMs` 800, `guardSlideMs` 500, `guardSlideStunMs` 4000. `overhaul.administrator`: `shieldDownMs` 4000 (the brief's 4 s), `callDelayMs` 1500, `stampTravelMs` 700, `stampHalfWidthPx` 8, `furnitureSlideMs` 700, `furnitureSizePx` 16, `gravityStunMs` 3000, `returnSpeedPx` 60, `beamSweepMs` 900, `beamHalfWidthPx` 10, `teleportBehindPx` 28, `offerEveryAttacks` 2, `offerPauseMs` 1800. The attacks, telegraphs, cooldowns, damage and weights (door 14 s / 15, stamp 900 ms, gravity flip 1.5 s / 10 s, teleport 600 ms, beam worst) were already in `TUNING.bosses`.

## Decisions for the creative director to confirm

- A bay door that runs out while Andrew is elsewhere in the bay still cycles (back to the bay's start, full timer, no damage). Heavy hit only if he is at the door. The brief only says what happens when it closes on him; this stops him being sealed in.
- The Glove's pulse (key 3) also works switches, besides E, since both are "worked with the Glove".
- A ledge counts only when Andrew comes to rest on it by sliding. Standing on it does not.
- The lockdown's lift is a sixth door with no timer; its panel is the lift's `examinableId`.
- Flipping gravity back returns the furniture home and throws the Administrator to the wall opposite the flip; the furniture does not hit on the way back.
- The broadcast section completes at the fifth plug; the button is a separate saved step (`pressed`), so the Myko call "plugs all five and leaves the button" is the same state as a player who has just plugged the fifth.
- The Administrator's 2/3 health phase keeps guards and stamps; the third phase drops the shield and the guards.
